name: David Danced
overview: Scripture reveals that dancing is a heartfelt expression of worship and joy before the Lord, as seen when Miriam led the women with timbrels and dances after deliverance (Exodus 15:20). The Psalms further emphasize praising God through dance and music, celebrating His power to transform sorrow into gladness (Psalms 30:11, 149:3, 150:4). This biblical portrayal affirms that rejoicing in the Lord with dance is a fitting response to His salvation and goodness.
